in your logs shows that the installer is hitting a hard wall\u2014it's trying to write to the phone's root directory, which Android's security kernel blocks to protect the "brain" of the device. Because of this, even when
pkg

Ollama

rm -rf
$PREFIX
/var/lib/dpkg/lock*
dpkg --configure -a
# 2. Bridge the "Eyes" to Python 3.12

export
PYTHONPATH=
$PYTHONPATH
:/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/lib/python3.12/site-packages
ln -s
$PREFIX
/lib/python3.12/site-packages/cv2/cv2.so
$PREFIX
/lib/python3.12/site-packages/cv2.so 2>/dev/null

python -c
"import cv2; print('7 STATUS: SYSTEM REPAIRED. LOCKED ON.')"
